panel.name: workspace_editor

combo_box.name: workspace_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Workspaces are stored separately for each account.

check_box.name: workspace_remember_folders
check_box.label: Remember Inventory folders
check_box.tool_tip: For this save: restore single-folder roots and view modes, or a selected folder and expanded branches in All Items (up to 256). Search filters and item selections are not saved.

check_box.name: workspace_capture_chat
check_box.label: Chat window size and position
check_box.tool_tip: Tabbed Conversations restores size and position only.

button.label: Add Inventory window
button.name: workspace_add_inventory
button.tool_tip: Open one extra inventory window managed by workspaces. All open additional Inventory windows are also saved.

button.name: gesture_board_launcher
button.label: Open gesture board…
button.tool_tip: Choose Inventory gestures and customize launcher tiles; board edits save separately from Preferences.

combo_box.name: workspace_startup_name
combo_box.tool_tip: Choose a saved workspace. Restore waits for UI and Inventory readiness.

panel.text: Login restores are per account. The last arrangement excludes workspace tools and Preferences.

check_box.name: workspace_snapping
check_box.label: Snap utility windows (hold Shift to bypass)

button.name: recover_windows
button.label: Recover windows now
button.tool_tip: Preview fitting live supported windows. OK keeps recovery; Cancel restores the previous arrangement.

panel.text: Click OK to keep your changes or Cancel to restore the previous arrangement.
